value.synopsis: Due to a freak accident, Momoka gets blasted by a ray that infuses her with her father's ruthless, businesslike personality. She promptly begins to take over the Keroro Platoon and attempt her own take-over of Earth. It's up to Fuyuki to stop her, but can he bring himself to hurt her?
